scientific_integrity: Exact analytical proof with independent finite-dimensional computational corroboration; no unique-optimizer claim and no exhaustive prior-art guarantee.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies optimality of one explicit candidate, not the FMMC optimum throughout the complementary parameter region. Earlier technical report has month-only public date (February 2003); the reported public date is verified for the directly inspected 2007 preprint. No independent assessment has occurred.
title: Sharp rational fastest-mixing regime for unbalanced double-star trees
